supports.excerpt:
Llama Stack
AgentOps provides support for Llama Stack Python Client(>=0.0.53), allowing you to monitor your Agentic applications.

- [AgentOps integration example 1](https://github.com/AgentOps-AI/agentops/pull/530/files/65a5ab4fdcf310326f191d4b870d4f553591e3ea#diff-fdddf65549f3714f8f007ce7dfd1cde720329fe54155d54389dd50fbd81813cb)
- [AgentOps integration example 2](https://github.com/AgentOps-AI/agentops/pull/530/files/65a5ab4fdcf310326f191d4b870d4f553591e3ea#diff-6688ff4fb7ab1ce7b1cc9b8362ca27264a3060c16737fb1d850305787a6e3699)
- [Official Llama Stack Python Client](https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-stack-client-python)

SwarmZero AI
Track and analyze SwarmZero agents with full observability. Set an `AGENTOPS_API_KEY` in your environment and initialize AgentOps to get started.

skill_drafts.name: AgentOps Integration Setup
skill_drafts.description: Initialize and configure AgentOps monitoring for agentic applications by setting environment variables and instantiating the AgentOps client. Enables observability and tracking for agent systems during deployment preparation.
skill_drafts.objective: Enable monitoring and observability for agent applications
applicable_signals: Agent framework selected and ready for instrumentation
contraindications: Agent system is already fully instrumented with AgentOps
Monitoring is not required for the use case
API credentials (AGENTOPS_API_KEY) are unavailable or invalid
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Set environment variable', 'detail': 'Configure AGENTOPS_API_KEY in your environment with valid AgentOps API credentials'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Import AgentOps client', 'detail': 'Import the AgentOps library appropriate for your framework (e.g., Llama Stack Python Client >=0.0.53)'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Initialize client', 'detail': 'Instantiate AgentOps client in application startup, before agent execution begins'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Verify telemetry', 'detail': 'Confirm monitoring data is flowing to AgentOps dashboard'}
triggers: Integrating AgentOps into an existing agent framework
Deploying an agent system that requires observability
constraints: AGENTOPS_API_KEY must be set before client initialization
AgentOps client library version must be compatible with target framework
Network connectivity to AgentOps backend required for telemetry transmission
cautions: Do not commit API credentials to version control; use environment variable injection
Verify API key validity before deployment to avoid silent monitoring failures
Check framework compatibility matrix for AgentOps client version support
output_contract: AgentOps client successfully initialized and connected; AGENTOPS_API_KEY environment variable set and validated; monitoring telemetry actively flowing to AgentOps dashboard; agent application ready for observability tracking

metadata.prompt: To set up AgentOps monitoring: (1) Set the AGENTOPS_API_KEY environment variable with your AgentOps API credentials. (2) Import and initialize the AgentOps client in your application startup code. (3) Verify that monitoring telemetry is flowing to the AgentOps dashboard. Refer to framework-specific integration examples (e.g., Llama Stack, SwarmZero) for language and SDK-specific initialization patterns.

skill_drafts.name: Framework-Specific AgentOps Integration
skill_drafts.description: Locate and apply framework-native AgentOps instrumentation patterns for a target agent framework (Llama Stack, SwarmZero, CrewAI, LangChain, Anthropic, Mistral, etc.). Use when adding observability to an existing framework-based agent system.
skill_drafts.objective: Provide framework-specific integration guidance and code examples for AgentOps observability
applicable_signals: Selecting AgentOps support for a particular agent framework
Implementing observability in a framework-based agent system
Framework is in the supported integration list (Llama Stack, SwarmZero, CrewAI, LangChain, Anthropic, Mistral, OpenAI Agents SDK, Cohere, CamelAI, LiteLLM, LlamaIndex)
contraindications: Framework is not in the supported AgentOps integration list
Custom agent implementation without framework dependency
triggers: Selecting or implementing AgentOps support for a particular agent framework (Llama Stack, SwarmZero, CrewAI, LangChain, Anthropic, Mistral, etc.)
constraints: Code examples and official client library must be available for the target framework
output_contract: Reference documentation and code examples identified for the target framework; integration approach clarified and ready for implementation

metadata.prompt: Identify the target agent framework. Consult the AgentOps integration reference to find the framework-specific integration approach, code examples, and official client library. Apply the framework-native instrumentation pattern to enable monitoring.
